verdict.rationale: monday.com's own marketing says its in-product agents can surface "deep intelligence and actionable insights from any subject." It also claims they spot risks and progress gaps, automate status and performance reports, summarize calls into action items, and score deals from board data. That covers the core of the story. However, all of this is marketing-level copy with no detailed documentation or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how insights and suggestions are generated from user data, independent or hands-on corroboration that the insights work as claimed.
